part.description: The type of project to generate

workspaceName.description: Name of the parent workspace, used to derive the project package name. Optional - when omitted, `name` is used as the whole package name instead of being appended to the workspace name.

name.description: Name used to derive the project package name. When `workspaceName` is set, the package name is `${workspaceName}-${name}` (replacing the previous `${workspaceName}-${part}` suffix). When `workspaceName` is absent, `name` becomes the whole package name. Defaults to `part`.

directory.description: Full destination path for this project (e.g. "apps/client", "packages/player-client"). The caller is responsible for including any part-specific segment - it is not appended automatically.

workspace.description: Whether this project is generated inside an existing NanoForge workspace

docker.description: Generate a Dockerfile for the project. Ignored when `workspace` is true - a project inside a workspace is built and run by the workspace's own Dockerfile instead.

hasServer.description: Only meaningful when part is "client": whether the client talks to a companion server. True adds the network library, the position packet and the position-sync system, so the entity position comes from the server; false leaves the network out. A server project always simulates and broadcasts its own position, regardless of this flag.

agents.description: Generate an AGENTS.md file documenting the project for AI coding agents, and a CLAUDE.md that imports it

libs.description: Relative paths to shared libs this project depends on

allowBuilds.description: Package names allowed to run install/build scripts. Only applies to a standalone project (workspace: false); ignored otherwise since the workspace root already handles it.
